run_card.hypothesis: Active Quaternary range-front splays and synthetic piedmont step-faults concentrate in the thin-cover piedmont accommodation apron (Band 12 det_elev transition x Band 15 depth_to_base_surf ~20-600 m x Band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope), expressing as coherent DEM slope-breaks (Bands 19/12) or shallow-buried Reduced-to-Pole magnetic gradient x inverted tc curvature 1D ridges (Bands 2/6) centered vertically over basement contacts.
run_card.mechanism: APRONRIDGE free1d: standalone physics-first 1D crest emission allocates all 37654 unit-mass dots via spaced_top_mask(S_raw, min_dist=2.8 px) on 4-axis non-maximum-suppressed APRONRIDGE crests (S_raw = H_apron * max(R_scarp, 0.85 * R_rtp), d_cat > 2.0 px), using ZERO H19-5 skeleton, ZERO R0 parent dots, and ZERO catalogue input in surface or weights.
run_card.named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Intermediate-elevation pluvial shoreline benches (Sehoo/Eetza recessional strandlines) and Gilbert-delta toes on piedmont fans, incised alluvial-fan terrace risers / wash walls, and remanently magnetized Tertiary basaltic-andesite flow margins beneath thin gravel.
